build_OmnimatteTrainer: build a python module to instantiate OmnimatteTrainer with img_batch_size and output path for foreground training
train_OmnimatteTrainer_fg: train the OmnimatteTrainer foreground model by calling _train_fg with a batch dictionary of tensors
render_OmnimatteTrainer_one_image: render a single image using OmnimatteTrainer _render_one_image method with a frame dictionary
review_OmnimatteTrainer_render_fg: review the OmnimatteTrainer _render_fg method that computes background flow and delegates to render_omnimatte_fg
refactor_OmnimatteTrainer_post_step: refactor the OmnimatteTrainer _post_step method to customize post-training behavior after each global step
